subject: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up — Elara Health

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 follow-up — Elara Health

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of requirements we heard:
- PHI in workflows (patient summaries + intake forms).
- SOC 2 Type II required by audit next quarter.
- Need a signed BAA and evidence of SOC 2 controls (report or bridge letter).
- Preference for isolated environment if we store PHI long-term; open to hosted with strong controls if logs and retention meet requirements.

Deployment options we discussed (brief):
- Hosted API: fastest to get started; supports customer-managed keys and strict retention policies, but data flows through Redwood multitenant endpoints. Good if you want quick POC.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools / single-tenant capacity in our cloud region; better isolation and dedicated SLA; recommended if you need predictable throughput + stronger separation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation and customer-controlled infra; for regulated customers with strict auditing requirements or on-prem constraints.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached the security questionnaire you mentioned — please flag any gaps.
2) We’ll spin up a quick Dedicated capacity estimate and share cost/lead time (Dylan).
3) I’ll send a BAA draft and SOC 2 evidence we can share with your legal and audit teams (Rishi).
4) Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security/audit folks next week? 

Let me know availability (I’ve copied Dylan + Rishi to coordinate).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our security team before we lock a follow-up: 

1) For Hosted API: can you confirm where PHI is stored transiently (logs, request stores)? What retention defaults apply and can we configure automatic deletion after X days?
2) For Dedicated: what is the separation boundary — is it tenant-level on shared hardware or truly single-tenant VMs? Any chance we get a simple diagram?
3) SOC 2: do you have a current Type II report or a SOC 2 bridge letter? Our auditor will want to see the latest testing period and any control exceptions.
4) BAA: we’ll need to review a draft with our legal — please send for initial redline.

Putting Procurement on copy for the BAA and SOW routing. For scheduling, Friday morning PDT works for our security lead.

Hi Sarah — following up on the SOC 2 / BAA items: 

- SOC 2 evidence: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report for the period Jan–Dec 2025. I’ve attached a redacted copy that’s safe for sharing with auditors (summary + controls). If they need an unredacted report, we can arrange an NDA and provide it.
- Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter if the auditor requests it for the gap between report end date and go-live.
- BAA: attaching a BAA draft for your legal team to review — it’s our standard template. We’re open to reasonable redlines; please route them back to procurement@redwood.com.

Regarding Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private: 
- Hosted API: data centers are multitenant but we support KMS integrations and per-customer key wrapping; retention settings can be set to 7/30/90 days and we can remove request logs on a per-account basis on request (note: ephemeral KV caching used for performance is not persisted beyond session by default).
- Dedicated: logically single-tenant within a pool; compute may be co-located on shared racks but isolated at orchestration and network level; we can provide a topology diagram (attached). For absolute physical isolation we recommend Private VPC / on-prem.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full network isolation, customer-managed VMs or air-gapped options; longer lead time and additional ops cost.

Next steps from our side:
1) Marissa will share Dedicated cost/lead time.
2) I’ve attached the redacted SOC 2 summary and BAA draft (Redwood_BAA_Draft.docx).
3) We can prepare a short topology diagram for Dedicated vs Hosted.

If you want, we can also do a short technical meeting with our infra lead to walk through logging/retention controls before your auditor call.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
